narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy, flowing delivery that runs sentences together with no pauses.

sara.instruct: Flat, blunt, deadpan young woman, unimpressed and slightly exasperated with her friend, quick.

mila.instruct: Dreamy, breathless, starry-eyed young woman, soft and sighing, totally in love, quick.

wife.instruct: Warm, casual, cheerful married woman teasing her husband, bright and quick.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Pisces friend got one smile and planned the wedding.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It was the barista and she already named their three children.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Mila who's dreamy and kind and mostly in her head.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She cries at sunsets. She says sorry to furniture.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's picked the wedding dress, the song, and the dog.

lines.speaker: sara
lines.text: Mila, you don't even know his name.

lines.speaker: mila
lines.text: His name tag says Sam. It's literally fate.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every morning she comes back, and every morning he smiles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then a woman walks behind the counter.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She kisses the barista and she's wearing a ring.

lines.speaker: wife
lines.text: Babe, you forgot your lunch again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mila turns around and walks straight into the glass door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Pisces?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a fish tank labelled DAYDREAMS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's huge and it's always overflowing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Next to it a dial labelled REALITY fell off years ago.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A tap marked TEARS that nobody can close.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a speaker playing SAD SONGS on repeat.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mila cries for one evening, then feels completely fine.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The next morning, she tries the flower shop instead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The florist hands her a rose and smiles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Mila has already named their dog.
